source_note: Seven context slots are Operations/Interpretation Library constructs. They are not CORE enums in specs/v3.1/canonical_vocabulary.json or runtime/v31/engine.py. Natural language must not write back into force/S07 (DUYEN_DICH_v3.1.md §4.3).

contexts.structural_meaning: Uses identity.moving_lines, per_line bits, msie nodes only.
contexts.context_mapping: Frame structural nodes as participants/relations when evidence names them.

contexts.structural_meaning: Uses identity and dynamic_state slots without inventing job titles.
contexts.context_mapping: Frame nodes as roles/tasks only when evidence supplies role labels.

contexts.structural_meaning: Numeric field values remain measurements; not currency amounts.
contexts.context_mapping: Map to resource language only with evidence of asset/transaction type.

contexts.structural_meaning: velocity/delay/spacetime are null in current engine; do not invent motion.
moving_lines mark structural change candidates; not the decision itself.
contexts.context_mapping: Decision language requires an explicit decision question + options in evidence.

contexts.structural_meaning: question text is input observation; not kernel force.
contexts.context_mapping: Intent statements stay in provenance/observation, never alter identity.

contexts.structural_meaning: Engine is single-tick; no prediction head in CORE.
contexts.context_mapping: Forecast language is Operations-only and must carry uncertainty + CALIBRATION_REQUIRED when S07/profile unapproved.

steps: Extract CORE FACT: identity.*, moving_lines, per_line if present.
Select context_id from operations request (not from CORE).
Run evidence_gates.json; if fail → stop with gate code.
Produce structural_meaning block only from confirmed fields.
Produce applied_image only if evidence_refs non-empty and gates pass; else UNSUPPORTED.

core_enum_check.evidence: specs/v3.1/canonical_vocabulary.json has s07_states and non_semantic_states only; no RELATIONSHIP/WORK/MONEY/MOVEMENT/DECISION/INTENT/FORECAST
